name: Library Wing (Northshire)
summary: The Library Wing is the quiet, book-lined southern wing of Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest. It serves as a sanctuary for scholars, offering early instruction to fledgling priests and mages joining the defense of Stormwind.

sections.title: Haven of Arcane and Divine Study
sections.body: Branching south from the Main Hall of Northshire Abbey, the Library Wing houses dusty shelves, study lecterns, and quiet alcoves dedicated to intellectual and spiritual training. While martial recruits drill in the northern Hall of Arms, aspiring mages and priests gather here to grasp the fundamentals of the Arcane and the Holy Light. Currently, Priestess Anetta guides novice priests in matters of faith and healing, while Khelden Bremen teaches budding mages how to shape primal elemental energy.

faq.q: Where is the Library Wing located?
faq.answer: The Library Wing occupies the southern section of Northshire Abbey, situated just off the Main Hall. It sits directly opposite the martial Hall of Arms.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this wing?
aliases: why does northshire abbey have a library
faq.answer: It serves as the academic and spiritual center of Northshire Abbey, dedicated to scholarly research, magical instruction, and prayer for recruits training to serve the Kingdom of Stormwind.

angles.text: Priestess Anetta resides here, offering fledgling priests their very first lessons in channeling the Holy Light to mend wounds and smite foes.
Khelden Bremen instructs novice mages within these quiet halls, teaching the foundational disciplines of fire and frost.
